description:
Start a counterpart search for one circular opportunity, by the `handle` from list_circular_opportunities. Debits credits and returns a jobId immediately; poll get_discovery_status then get_discovery_results exactly as for find_prospects. What is searched for is derived server-side from the graded opportunity — you pass a handle, not criteria.

When the entry has `requires_resource_confirmation: true`, its resource is something WE INFERRED rather than something the customer stated, and this call is REFUSED (404 `resource_confirmation_required`, no charge) unless you pass `confirmed_resource`. ASK THE CUSTOMER FIRST and send THEIR WORDING — do not echo our label back and do not invent one. Their answer is retained as a stated fact about their business and informs every later inference, so a guess becomes a durable error. An unknown handle is refused with a refund.
name: run_circular_opportunity
title: Run circular opportunity
